purpose: Normative canonicalization profile for reproducible R3H1 hashing and cross-implementation round trips.

rules: Parse dense shorthand into the canonical object before hashing.
ts MUST be RFC3339 UTC using Z.
src MUST be an object with only N,P,M,T,A keys; unavailable values MUST be Q, not invented.
prov MUST be an array; unknown provenance is represented as ["Q"].
body MUST be either a UTF-8 string preserved exactly after NFC normalization or a JSON value canonicalized recursively.
Object keys MUST be serialized in lexicographic order.
Numbers MUST use JSON decimal representation without NaN or Infinity.
Booleans and null use standard JSON literals.
Serialization MUST use separators ',' and ':' with no insignificant whitespace.
The SHA-256 digest is computed over the canonical UTF-8 bytes and encoded as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
Unknown extension fields are forbidden unless nested under link/ext in a future versioned profile.
canonicalization.note: Aliases that are not canonical-object fields are semantic annotations and must be mapped into body or a future versioned extension before hashing.

receiver: only then evaluate replay and semantics
pass_conditions: two independent implementations produce identical canonical bytes
two independent implementations produce identical SHA-256
tampering any hashed field changes the digest
missing provenance/source evidence remains Q rather than inferred
